description: This file contains functions and scripts for handling platform-specific upgrade processes in OpenWRT, such as checking images, copying configs, updating EFI system partitions, and performing the main upgrade logic.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image has a matching partition layout before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data from backup to the installed partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that performs partition updates, image writing, and configuration adjustments.
